title: Bitchain Manifest (format v2)
description: Content-addressed fragment-tree manifest produced by `bitchain pack` and consumed by `bitchain unpack`. See docs/manifest-format.md for the full field-by-field writeup this schema mirrors — kept in lockstep by hand with src/manifest.rs per that file's own module doc comment; there is no schema-to-Rust codegen in this repo.

format_version.description: Manifest format version. Always 2 for this schema. `Manifest::from_json` rejects any other value; there is no v1 (SHA-256 / flat block list) read path in this crate.

partition_id.description: 16-byte partition id, hex-encoded (32 hex chars). Canonically BLAKE3(household/namespace-string)[0:16].

path.description: Relative path as packed; used as the target path under --output-dir on unpack.

context.description: 16-byte logical identity, hex-encoded. All-zero (ANONYMOUS) unless `pack --identity` was supplied.

root_hash.description: BLAKE3 hash (32 bytes, hex-encoded) of the fragment tree's root block.

root_type.description: leaf: content fit in one chunk, no fold levels. list: one or more list-node fold levels sit above the leaves.

depth.description: Number of list-node levels above the leaves. Not part of the object's address; fully determined by chunking_profile + input length, carried for reconstruction convenience.

uncompressed_len.description: Total byte length of the original content. unpack checks the reconstructed length against this field and fails on mismatch.

block_size.description: Every chunk is block_size bytes except possibly the last.

x-schema-history: This schema described the retired v1 format (SHA-256 hashes, flat files[].blocks[] list, version: "1.0" string) until 2026-08-23, when it was rewritten to match the shipped format-v2 Manifest/ManifestEntry shape in src/manifest.rs as part of CLUS-20. No v1 manifest validates against this schema; there is no --legacy read path in the CLI either (see docs/manifest-format.md).
